name: NEXTDC D1 Darwin

address.note: Address per NEXTDC D1 tech specs (source 8) and NEXTDC/NT Govt plans release (source 11). DCA Darwin minutes (source 10, search snippet only) describe the D1 permit site as 8 Ryko Court (the lot appears to front both streets). D2 is at 2-6 Ryko Court.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '2 Harvey Street, Darwin City NT 0800' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('NEXTDC Darwin D1, 2, Harvey Street, One Mile Dam, Darwin Cit') is 67m away.

builder.note: head contractor (Kapitol Group NT per source 9); confirmed on Kapitol project page (source 7), architect Hames Sharley

developer.note: selected by NT Government via Expression of Interest

mw_it.note: target capacity 7 MW (opening release; facility page says 7+ MW design, source 3). Groundbreaking release and Kapitol page said 8 MW (sources 1,7). Facility page shows 1MW+ built.

cost_aud_m.note: '$80 million D1 Darwin data centre facility' (NEXTDC); same in opening release (source 2)

pathway.value: Development application under NT Planning Act 1999 (consent required: data centre undefined use, NT Planning Scheme 2020)

reference.note: Development permit number cited in DCA Darwin minutes No. 440 (4 Apr 2025) for the 'first stage ... data centre located at 8 Ryko Court'; seen via search snippet only (PDF behind Cloudflare, 403). PA application number not found.

determined.note: DCA Darwin Division meeting 408 heard the NEXTDC data centre application; permit DP23/0213 (2023 series) consistent with this. Decision text not read (PDF 403).

jobs_construction.note: NT Chief Minister: 'Supporting over 200 jobs during construction and 20 jobs when operational' (lower bound)

jobs_construction_other.note: NEXTDC: 'will create more than 200 jobs in the region throughout the life of the project and into the daily operation of the facility' - combined construction + operations

jobs_operational.note: NT Chief Minister: '20 jobs when operational'

construction_end.note: official opening; Kapitol says 'completed in July 2024' (source 7)

open_questions: DCA minutes 408 and 440 are behind Cloudflare (403): DP23/0213 number and 18 Aug 2023 consent known only from search snippets
scope: 7 MW target design but only ~1 MW+ built initially (facility page '1MW+')
